# EveryGyan

> Knowledge for Everyone, Everywhere. EveryGyan is an independent digital publication providing verified journalism, hands-on tutorials, travel itineraries, German language learning, and interactive browser games.

## Core Sections & Editorial Pillars
- [About EveryGyan](https://everygyan.com/about): Editorial mission, team masthead, publishing standards, and ethics.
- [Contact Editorial Team](https://everygyan.com/contact): Direct contact details for press inquiries, feedback, and story pitches.
- [World & Regional Travel](https://everygyan.com/category/travel): Verified destination guides, family itineraries, budget ranges, and transit tips.
- [Technology & Modern AI](https://everygyan.com/category/tech): Modern software engineering, agentic AI frameworks, benchmarks, and cloud architecture.
- [German Language Curriculum](https://everygyan.com/category/learn-german): Structured CEFR A1 to B1 grammar lessons, vocabulary, and everyday fluency.
- [Enterprise Cloud & SAP Tutorials](https://everygyan.com/category/tutorials): Enterprise ERP architectures, cloud migration strategies, and technical guides.
- [Online Browser Gaming Hub](https://everygyan.com/category/entertainment-games): Playable classical Chess Master against AI bots and 2048 high-score puzzle.
- [Daily Deals & Curated Gear](https://everygyan.com/deals): Verified shopping deals, tech gear, and productivity software recommendations.

## Featured Lead Articles & Reference Guides
- [10 Amazing Places to Visit in Europe with Family](https://everygyan.com/article/europe-travel-destinations): Comprehensive family-friendly European destinations from Swiss alpine trails to Mediterranean coasts.
- [Modern AI & Machine Learning: Navigating Agentic Software](https://everygyan.com/article/modern-ai-engineering-trends): Architecture principles for autonomous reasoning models, tool calling, and evaluation pipelines.
- [German A1 to B1 Complete Language Roadmap](https://everygyan.com/category/learn-german): Step-by-step curriculum covering German cases, vocabulary drills, and practical dialogues.
- [Browser Chess Master](https://everygyan.com/category/entertainment-games): Interactive chess game engine with tactical AI difficulty levels and move analysis.
- [2048 Puzzle Master](https://everygyan.com/category/entertainment-games): 4x4 sliding tile puzzle game with Web Audio feedback and statistics persistence.

## Legal & Compliance Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://everygyan.com/privacy): Data protection, user rights, and cookie management details.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://everygyan.com/terms): Terms of service, editorial fair-use, and intellectual property.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- [XML Sitemap](https://everygyan.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable index of published articles and categories.
- [MCP Server Card](https://everygyan.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): SEP-1649 Model Context Protocol server capabilities.
- [Markdown Index](https://everygyan.com/index.md): Pure Markdown representation of the EveryGyan portal.
- [Full LLMs Context](https://everygyan.com/llms-full.txt): Extended multi-page context for autonomous agents.
